name: Pandas
purpose: It solves the problem of efficiently handling and processing tabular and time-series data, which is often messy and unstructured in real-world scenarios. Pandas enables data scientists and ML engineers to clean, transform, and analyze data, making it suitable for various stages of data science and machine learning workflows.
coreComponents: Panel (for three-dimensional data, though less common in recent versions)
keyCapabilities: Data loading and saving from various formats (CSV, Excel, SQL, JSON, HDF5)
Data cleaning and preprocessing (handling missing values, duplicates, type conversion)
Data manipulation (filtering, sorting, merging, joining, reshaping, pivoting, grouping)
Exploratory Data Analysis (descriptive statistics, aggregation, correlation)
Time series functionality (date/time handling, resampling, windowing)
useCases: Data cleaning and preprocessing for machine learning models
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to understand data patterns and insights
Financial data analysis and time series forecasting
Retail analytics for customer behavior and sales trends
